title: Doubling Up
summary: If adding does not fit, test multiplying.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: What comes next, and what is the rule?

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: The gaps are 3, 6, 12, which are not constant.
So try dividing instead of subtracting.
points: The gaps are 3, 6, 12, which are not constant.

steps.title: The method: Check the ratio
sentences: 6 divided by 3 is 2. 12 divided by 6 is 2. 24 divided by 12 is 2.
Each number is double the one before it.
points: 6 divided by 3 is 2. 12 divided by 6 is 2. 24 divided by 12 is 2.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: If differences do not work, try multiplying or dividing.

quiz.why: Each is times 3, so 54 times 3 is 162.
